english.text: On the 27th of March of 2015, Yaroslav and I discuss the Earth Mother statues, resembling fat women, in pre-Roman Old Europe. Then, I ask him what genre of literature Tolstoy's writings are, but he does not give a definitive answer. He watched the Lord of the Rings movies in Russian, but he says that he is not a fan of fantasy and they were too long. Those movies have made New Zealand a more famous country, Yaroslav's favourite. I like Lord of the Rings in French.

text: 喺2015年3月27號，我同雅羅斯拉夫討論咗羅馬前期嘅舊歐洲嘅地母雕像，好似肥婆噉。然後，我問佢托爾斯托伊嘅作品係咩類型嘅文學，但係佢冇畀一個確定嘅答案。佢睇咗俄文嘅《魔戒》電影，但係佢話佢唔係奇幻嘅粉絲，而且佢哋太長，令紐西蘭成為一個更加出名嘅國家，雅羅斯拉夫最鍾意嘅法文。
